_about: Per-run cost ceiling. A nonprofit cannot absorb a surprise API bill, and 'it got expensive' is how a pilot dies quietly. So cost is a gate like any other: a run that would exceed the ceiling halts and reports rather than completing and billing.
_ceiling_rationale: Sized for a monthly report over ~6 sources with the metric dictionary cached. Deliberately tight: a run that needs more than this has usually gone wrong (a retry loop, an unfiltered source dump) rather than legitimately grown.

pricing_usd_per_mtok._warning: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER RATES for deterministic offline tests. These are NOT current prices and must never be quoted to a client. The live suite resolves real rates at call time.

posture._batch_note: A monthly board report is not interactive. A 24-hour turnaround is irrelevant against a monthly deadline, and batch halves both input and output. This is the single most under-used lever for this workflow.
posture._cache_note: The metric dictionary and source register are identical across every run in a month.

model_routing._routing_note: Frontier model reserved for genuinely ambiguous conflicts. Sweeps and extraction are cheap-model work.
